name: Science and Practice of Happiness
topics: Concepts of Happiness and Subjective Well-being

Environment and Quality of Life (Veenhoven's Matrix)
Using the given scenario, evaluate how environmental factors affect subjective well-being and recommend improvements.

Analyse how strengths such as hope and perseverance contribute to team well-being; how can others identify and cultivate such strengths?
Compare a judger's and a learner's mindset in the given stress scenario; how can one shift to a positive, problem-solving mindset?
